column1: # Benchmark 8's community, written out in full: 12 genomes, six known in GTDB r207
# and six whose species is new in r214, with six of the 12 from a single genus
# (Streptomyces) independently of that split. Coverage and truth taxonomy are stated
# here rather than looked up in the GTDB metadata, because the six novel genomes have
# no r207 metadata row -- see ../rules/data_generation_community.smk.
# role: known    = species present in every r207 database; truth is the full species
#       novel    = species new in r214 (genus known); truth stops at genus
# The three novel Streptomyces share one truth lineage and so are summed into a
# single g__Streptomyces row at 1000 + 10 + 3 = 1013x. That is deliberate: the
# benchmark asks whether a profiler leaves that 1013x at the genus, or spends it on
# the nearest known congener (the 200x S. rimosus is the obvious candidate).
# Reads for the six known genomes come from ../reference_genomes/shadow (the Zenodo
# shadow pool, gathered by ../gather_tool_databases.smk); the six novel ones are
# downloaded from NCBI by that same file's bench89_novel_genomes_download rule.
# Provenance: this file was reconstructed from the reads of the original run, whose
# per-genome origin is recoverable from the ART read names (each is
# <source contig>-<index>). Every known genome's taxonomy is its r207 GTDB lineage,
# every coverage here is within 1.3% of the reads*2*150/genome_length measured from
# those reads (ART under-delivers slightly, since a fragment cannot straddle a contig
# end), and the truth this file produces reproduces the recorded sample5.condensed
# exactly.
